summary: Persistent PlanRun store is implemented as agent_core::run_store with a RunStore trait, file-backed snapshots, temp-file write staging, recoverable run listing, observation hashes, tamper detection, and AuditJournal-based effect seal checks.

acceptance.criterion: PlanRun state survives process restart in tests.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_store::tests::plan_run_state_survives_reopened_store creates a run, updates AwaitingApproval/current_step_id, reopens FileRunStore, and reloads the same state.

acceptance.criterion: Partial state writes do not produce a silently corrupted run.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_store::tests::interrupted_temp_write_is_ignored_in_favor_of_latest_valid_snapshot writes a malformed .json.tmp and verifies the latest valid .json snapshot is loaded.

acceptance.criterion: Recoverable runs can be listed by state.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_store::tests::list_recoverable_runs_excludes_terminal_runs lists non-terminal runs and excludes Completed runs.

acceptance.criterion: RunStore never claims an effect is sealed unless the audit journal contains the matching seal event.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_store::tests::audit_journal_remains_source_of_truth_for_sealed_effects returns false before CommitSealed, true only when run_id, step_id, and parameter_hash match AuditJournal.

acceptance.criterion: Secret-like values are redacted or rejected before persistence.
acceptance.evidence: agent_core::run_store::tests::secret_like_values_are_rejected_before_persistence rejects token-like current_step_id updates and verifies persisted snapshots do not contain the secret value.

run_store_contract.snapshot_strategy: monotonic JSON snapshots; write .json.tmp then rename to .json; recovery ignores .tmp files
run_store_contract.effect_truth: AuditJournal remains source of truth for CommitSealed; RunStore only queries audit timeline

migration_note: The RunStore trait isolates create/load/update/list/effect-seal queries so FileRunStore can be replaced by SQLite/WAL later without changing AgentCore scheduling semantics.
